card.name: Odd-cased pieces inside abbreviations and acronyms
card.fires_on: A short, oddly cased piece in the middle of an acronym or abbreviation, such as the n in Issn, Cr in CrCL, or d in TdP. It is also found in names like Nasa, AiG and Usenet.

modes.label: Abbreviation pieces
modes.description: A lowercase or mixed-case piece partway through a medical or technical abbreviation.

modes.label: Capitalised word after a title
modes.description: A capitalised short word such as Pdf in a resource heading.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward uppercase letter pieces that continue an acronym or name, and away from code-like lowercase pieces.
card.plain: It fires inside acronyms and abbreviations that are split into odd pieces, like Issn, CrCL or TdP.
